questions.question: Give two natural foods and name at least three nutrients found in each.
questions.expected_answer: Egg: protein, fat, vitamins such as vitamin A and D, and minerals such as iron. Milk: protein, fat, a natural sugar, calcium and vitamins. Dried beans: starch, protein, fibre and iron. Peanuts: oil, protein and some carbohydrate.

questions.question: If a food contains many nutrients, how do we decide which group to put it in? Give an example.
questions.expected_answer: We put it in the group of the nutrient it has the most of. A mealie is mostly starch, so it is a carbohydrate food. An avocado is mostly oil, so it is in the fats and oils group. A food label shows how much of each nutrient is in the food.

questions.question: Describe a test for starch and a test for fat.
questions.expected_answer: For starch, put a drop of brown iodine solution on the food; it turns blue-black if starch is there. For fat, rub the food on brown paper and let it dry, then hold it up to the light; a see-through, or translucent, spot that stays after drying shows fat or oil.
